explanation: In Turkish business culture, punctuality is valued but a 5-10 minute delay is often tolerated, especially if traffic is cited. However, arriving more than 15 minutes late without prior notice is considered disrespectful and may harm your professional reputation.
local_tip: Always call or message ahead if you anticipate being more than 10 minutes late, and apologize briefly upon arrival.
regional_note: In more conservative or traditional settings (e.g., eastern Anatolia), punctuality may be more relaxed, but in Istanbul and major business hubs, strict punctuality is increasingly expected.

also_check.note: Punctuality is critical; even one minute late can be seen as disrespectful.
Arriving 15-30 minutes late is common and often expected in business meetings.
Punctuality is a sign of respect; lateness is generally unacceptable.
